newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends mixed after quiet, short session.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends mixed after quiet, short session.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures ended a short pre-New Year holiday session mixed in minimal volume.
Few market players bothered with the market, which closed at 1230 GMT, and is also closed Wednesday. First trading of the new year will be on Thursday, January 2.
"It's quiet as expected ahead of the New Year," one trader said.
The lion's share of the volume was on front month March. It traded 42 lots of a total 53.
March last traded 40 cents higher at $309.00.
In physicals, Sri Lanka is tendering on January 8 to buy one cargo of white sugar for delivery in the second half of February, trade sources said.
